_comment: Bot wizards decide every 2.5s, so the model must answer within the decision timeout. Verified live against the NVIDIA key: nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b answers ~1-7s. gpt-oss-20b is registered too and gives smarter reasoning but ~10-25s/decision (constant scripted fallback). Swap the `name` to 'nvidia/gpt-oss-20b' if you accept slow decisions.
